concept: Committing to an ongoing volunteer effort, not just a one-time act
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student considers a realistic ongoing volunteer commitment (tutoring, community project, cause) that requires sustained effort rather than a single event
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether and how to commit given real competing demands on their time
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what sustained commitment requires that a one-time act doesn't

assessment.success_marker: student identifies a specific, realistic way to sustain the commitment over time
